notes.title: Alpha Version 0.3.1 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]0.3.1 Patch Log:[/b][/h3]

Fixes & Changes:
[list]
[*] Added confirmation before going to battle if there are upgrade materials left.
[*] Fixed bug when replacing rune, stats bonus from previous rune still applied.
[*] Fixed bug stacking runes with the same effect does not work properly.
[*] Fixed minor text inconsistencies in PT-BR language during story scene 1, 2 and 4.
[*] Tweaked the UI in the Graphics Menu to make it easier to distinguish between rows.
[*] Updated "Feedback" link in the title screen
[/list]

QoL Updates: 
[list]
[*] Automatically select "Wait" action when there is no other action that can be done during battle.
[*] Automatically select the previously used skill during battle.
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Increased Esmeralda's guard stats from 1 → 2
[*] Improved Esmeralda's skill Windslash damage from 70 → 80, range from 2 → 3
[*] Reduced Giant Toad's attack damage from 120 → 90
[*] Reduced Gigantis's guard stats from 8 → 5
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As this year comes to an end, I'd like to share a bit about the development of "Rebirth of Arcadia" and what to expect in 2024.

I've planned two demos for release in 2024. The first demo will focus on gathering player feedback regarding game balance, mechanics, and localization quality. The second demo will represent the final game.

Currently, the first demo version is being developed and tested. I'm aiming to release this version in January, most likely around the third or fourth week. The exact date will be announced later, once the demo is approved by Steam.

For those eager to try the game and provide feedback, stay tuned for the demo release!

Lastly, Happy holidays and a Happy New Year to everyone! See you next year!

-Monoclove
